get.description: Standard Copy URL import over HTTPS, with a random download-only capability token in the resource path. No Authorization header or administrator cookie is required. Validate expiry/revocation on every request; reset/delete invalidates old links without rotating still-valid proxy identities. Never log/export/analyze the capability URL, echo it in errors or redirect it. B08 implements this reserved operation.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Opaque URL-safe random token, at least 256 bits of entropy; never an administrator or proxy credential.

post.description: Explicit Copy URL action, also after detail refresh. Require administrator session, allowed Origin and CSRF. Recover the CURRENT token through B01 Cipher and the B08/010 credential reference; never force token reset on refresh. Ordinary list/detail DTOs exclude token and URL. Expired/revoked subscriptions return a redacted stable error.
